claims.aud: the Client the request is for

twoFactorAt.claimFormat: NumericDate; the Principal states it as RFC 3339 UTC

plainHeaders.rule: The Gate sets every plain header on every allowed answer, empty when the field has no value, so a caller's copy of a header can never stand in for one the Gate left out. A reader of the contract reads only the signed header.

refusals.missing: No signed header, whatever plain headers the request carries.
refusals.wrong-typ: The JWT's typ is not identity-principal+jwt.
refusals.wrong-audience: aud is not the reader's own Client.
refusals.expired: The reader's clock is at or past exp.
refusals.unknown-key: No key in the Issuer's JWKS has the JWT's kid.
refusals.bad-signature: The signature does not verify with the key the kid names.
refusals.unknown-major: ver names a major version the reader does not know.
